laws.k: gcc|BH|Decision regulating recruitment offices' licenses
laws.t: Decision regulating recruitment offices' licenses
laws.o: قرار بشأن تنظيم تراخيص مكاتب الاستقدام
laws.tp: recruitment: Employment/recruitment offices incl. domestic-worker recruitment. Bahraini ownership, LMRA-approved contract templates, BD 10,000 guarantee (Art. 2); no breach of Law 19/2006 Art. 23 fee ban as licence condition; guarantee compensates employers only (Art. 9); offices placing female domestic workers must provide temporary housing supervised by a woman (Art. 6). Amended by Res. 4/2023 and Res. 1/2026
laws.s2: Mengatur izin kantor perekrutan, termasuk untuk pekerja rumah tangga. Kantor wajib menyetor jaminan dan tidak boleh memungut biaya dari pekerja.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: Change of employer at any time with permission; without it, only with LMRA approval. Domestic workers have one week (others 30 days) to contest an absconding report.

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
coded.n: No person may take money or any benefit from a worker for a work permit, employment or keeping the job; prison of 3 months to 1 year and/or BHD 1,000-2,000, aggravated for domestic-worker permits and multiplied by the number of workers.

LMRA licence with Bahraini ownership, approved contract templates and a BHD 10,000 guarantee (which compensates employers only); offices placing women domestic workers must provide temporary housing supervised by a woman.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
coded.n: Ministry settlement or direct LMRA filing with translation and document help; no filing fee; hearing within two months.
